type NumberThenString<T extends { [k: number]: string }> = T[`${number}${string}`];
type TwoNumbers<T extends { [k: number]: string }> = T[`${number}${number}`];
type NumericString<T extends { [k: number]: string }> = T[`${number}`];
type BigIntString<T extends { [k: number]: string }> = T[`${bigint}`];
type Mixed<T extends { [k: number]: string }> = T[`${number}` | 1 | "5"];
type Literals<T extends { [k: number]: string }> = T[`${1 | 2}` | `${1}${2}`];
type FromNumber<T extends { [k: number]: string }, K extends number> = T[`${K}`];
type FromNumberTwice<T extends { [k: number]: string }, K extends number> = T[`${K}${K}`];
type FromNumericString<T extends { [k: number]: string }, K extends `${number}`> = T[K];
type FromNumericLiteral<T extends { [k: number]: string }, K extends "5"> = T[K];
type FromNumberLiteral<T extends { [k: number]: string }, K extends 5> = T[K];
type FromBranches<T extends { [k: number]: string }, K extends string> = T[K extends "a" ? "5" : "6"];
type ByString<T extends { [k: string]: string }, K extends `${number}${string}`> = T[K];
